title: Norm sections on local finite free affine charts
statement: Let s:Y→X be a finite flat locally finitely presented morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-finite-locally-free], W an open of X, and a a section of O_Y over s⁻¹(W). There is a section g of O_X on W such that every x in W has an affine open neighbourhood B contained in W with the section algebra Γ(Y,s⁻¹(B)) finite free over Γ(X,B), using s.app B for the algebra structure, and the restriction of g to B equals the finite free algebra norm of the restriction of a to s⁻¹(B). No constant rank, surjectivity, or affineness of W is assumed.

proof.text: Restrict s over W. On an affine neighbourhood of each point, finiteness makes the inverse image affine and its section algebra finite; local finite presentation makes this a finitely presented module and flatness makes it flat. Localize at the point, where a finite presented flat module over a local ring is free, and descend a basis to a principal neighbourhood. This supplies affine charts B contained in W with finite free section algebra.

On each chart, form the determinant of multiplication by a restricted to its inverse image. On overlaps, refine by affine principal neighbourhoods in both charts. Algebra.norm_localization identifies the restrictions, and determinant invariance under basis changes identifies the two computations. The sheaf property of O_X glues the compatible determinants to g on W, whose restrictions satisfy the asserted equalities. Rank may vary across charts; on a nonempty overlap it agrees locally. Empty inverse images have rank zero and determinant 1. Empty W gives a vacuous chart condition.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteLocallyFree_norm_charts
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsFinite s] [Flat s] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s]
    (W : X.Opens) (a : Γ(Y, s ⁻¹ᵁ W)) :
    ∃ g : Γ(X, W), ∀ x : X, x ∈ W →
      ∃ (B : X.Opens) (hBW : B ≤ W), x ∈ B ∧ IsAffineOpen B ∧
        (letI := (s.app B).hom.toAlgebra
         Module.Free Γ(X, B) Γ(Y, s ⁻¹ᵁ B) ∧
         Module.Finite Γ(X, B) Γ(Y, s ⁻¹ᵁ B) ∧
         X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hBW).op g =
           Algebra.norm Γ(X, B)
             (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (s.preimage_mono hBW)).op a))
